claims: Administer scheduled oral antihypertensive regimen (metoprolol succinate, amlodipine, lisinopril) and titrate IV nicardipine to maintain systolic BP below 160 mmHg.
Recheck serum sodium and free water deficit; administer enteral water or hypotonic fluids for hypernatremia (Na 148 mEq/L).
Replete potassium given level 3.5 mEq/L with ongoing IV potassium chloride replacement and recheck basic metabolic panel in 6-12 hours.
Continue telemetry/ST-segment monitoring and serial troponins/ECG for chest pain evaluation in the setting of hypertension.
Assess and treat moderate pain (5-6/10) with multimodal analgesia, using oxycodone or IV morphine as needed and reassessing response.
Maintain SpO2 above 92% with supplemental oxygen as needed and continue continuous pulse oximetry; assess for dyspnea.
Monitor fingerstick glucose (179 mg/dL) and continue glycemic control, avoiding hypoglycemia.
Perform fall precautions and mobility assessment; assist with out-of-bed mobility as tolerated given bed rest and fall risk.
Continue bowel regimen (senna, docusate, bisacodyl) and monitor bowel function.
Recheck CBC and coagulation profile in 12-24 hours given anemia (Hgb 10.9 g/dL) and monitor for bleeding.
